{{incomplete|needs=Release dates}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the [[List of animated series specials|animated series specials]] in {{pmin|the United Kingdom}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 2}}). ==Pokémon Chronicles== {{main|List of English language Pokémon Chronicles home video releases (Region 2)}} ==Dedicated releases== ===Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation=== {{incomplete|section|needs=Confirm titles of episodes on VHS}} The Pokémon [[Pikachu's Winter Vacation]] VHS was released in the United Kingdom in 2001 by {{wp|Warner Bros.}} with the catalogue number S021920. It contains four Pikachu shorts: ''[[PK02|Christmas Night]]'', ''[[PK03|Kanga Games]]'', ''[[PK05|Winter Games]]'', and ''[[PK06|Stantler's Little Helpers]]''. It was released as part of a promotion at some retailers in the United Kingdom, where customers would obtain the promotional {{Trading Card Game}} card {{TCG ID|Wizards Promo|Unown J|38}} and a {{DL|List of English language Pokémon animated special home video releases (Region 2)|Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation}} VHS with the purchase of the ''{{DL|List of English language Pokémon movie home video releases (Region 2)|Spell of the Unown: Entei}}'' VHS or DVD, which was released on October 8, 2001. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Pika}} |border={{colorschemedark|Pika}} |image1=Pikachu's Winter Vacation UK VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=VHS cover }} ===''Mewtwo Returns''=== ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]'' was released by {{wp|Warner Bros.}} on VHS in the United Kingdom on February 11, 2002 with the catalogue number S022141. A ''Mewtwo Returns'' VHS box set was also released with the catalogue number S022543 that contains both the ''Mewtwo Returns'' VHS and the [[S01|Indigo League]] VHS "[[List of English language Indigo League home video releases (Region 2)|The Great Race]]". The two VHS tapes have their own cases. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Mewtwo Returns UK VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=VHS cover |image2=Mewtwo Returns UK VHS box set.png |size2=x200px |caption2=VHS box set cover }} ===''Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness''=== ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness]]'' was released on DVD in the United Kingdom as a promotional item. The disc came in a DVD case. It was available as part of a goodie bag with an event in the United Kingdom. It was also available as a bonus for customers that purchased [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Darkness]], [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Versions|Pokémon Diamond, or Pokémon Pearl]] at {{wp|Woolworths}}. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Hoso}} |border={{colorschemedark|Hoso}} |image1=PMD Explorers Time Darkness UK DVD front.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover }} ==As bonus content== ===Pikachu shorts=== [[Pikachu short]]s are occasionally included in the same release as [[List of English language Pokémon movie home video releases (Region 2)|Pokémon movies]] on VHS and DVD. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Pika}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Pika}}; {{roundy|10px}}" !
